messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: metering-service detected a sustained token-count delta > 15% for outbound usage aggregation across the last 20m. Potential overage flags being emitted. Severity: P2. @jordan (oncall) has been paged.

jordan (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Any customer reports yet?

matt (support): we've got two customers (acme-inc, luminex) reporting unexpected overage emails in the last 30m. Tickets 8472, 8473. Not spam — receipts show inflated token counts.

samir (billing-eng): looking at the aggregation logs now. There's a backlog in the delta-aggregator consumer and a retry storm against redis. I see a deploy to metering-worker-3 ~22m ago, takes me to 2143653200 in logs.

elaine (eng-sre): can you paste the failing logs? If it's retry-related we might have double-apply semantics from the worker.

samir (billing-eng): log snippet: ```2026-03-15T21:45:12Z ERROR delta-apply id=tx=0x9a3 kv-commit-failed retry=5: EBUSY - redis write timeout``` Also seeing `duplicate-window` markers in the aggregator offsets.

jordan (oncall): rough customer impact estimate? Percentage of daily traffic affected?

samir (billing-eng): ballpark ~2.1% of token volume in the last hour, but for some tenants peak buckets doubled because of duplicate replays. Could surface as overage emails for a subset.

fiona (product): Ok — priority is to stop new incorrect counts going out and prevent billing charges from being finalized. Can we pause outbound billing exports and re-run reconciliation?

elaine (eng-sre): suggest these steps: 1) pause billing-export queue (non-destructive) 2) disable metering-worker auto-retry (flip feature flag) 3) start a controlled replay against reconciler with dedupe. We can sequence to stop customer-facing emails first.

jordan (oncall): agree. Executing step 1 now.

incidents-bot: Action executed: queue.billing-export paused by jordan (oncall) at 2143654385.

samir (billing-eng): I'll flip the retry flag on staging-like prod hosts. Command: ```curl -X POST https://config.redwood/v1/flags/metering.retry -d '{"value":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"``` Doing it in canary first.

samir (billing-eng): canary done on metering-worker-1/2. Observing a drop in duplicate write attempts.

matt (support): I've told acme-inc they're looked into and paused billing exports; asked them to hold off on refunds while we investigate. They want ETA on resolution.

fiona (product): Drafting a short message template for affected customers — emphasize paused exports and manual reconciliation. Will post once we have a confirmed scope.

elaine (eng-sre): Next step: run a bounded replay with dedupe enabled against a small shard to verify reconciler idempotency. Samir, can you prepare the replay job? Use `--dedupe=true --limit=5000`

samir (billing-eng): prepping job: ```run-replay --from ts=2143650000 --to ts=2143654300 --shard=7 --dedupe=true --limit=5000``` Kicking off now.

incidents-bot: Job replay-214365-replay-7 queued at 2143654570.

samir (billing-eng): replay finished on shard 7: dedupe removed ~8% duplicates, output deltas look sane. No new overcharge rows produced.

jordan (oncall): good sign. Do we have a safe window to unpause exports or do we need full reconciliation?

samir (billing-eng): I recommend keep exports paused until we run a full shard-by-shard replay. Estimated time ~3h. Can do parallel shards, but want manual checks at each step.

fiona (product): For customers who already received overage emails: propose manual crediting path + FAQ copy. We should avoid mass refunds until we confirm a clean reconciliation.

matt (support): I'll start outreach to the two reported customers with the template, label them high-touch.

jordan (oncall): Transferring handoff: Erin, you're next oncall in ~40m. I'll stay until exports are unpaused or we hit a safe handoff. @erin (next-oncall) please ack.

erin (next-oncall): acked. I'll shadow the replay progress and the billing export flag. Please DM if anything changes.

elaine (eng-sre): quick mitigation note for postmortem: root cause likely related to worker retry/offset handling after the recent metering-worker deploy. Action items: stricter idempotency in delta-apply, circuit-breaker on retry storms, add metric for duplicate write ratio.

samir (billing-eng): logging ticket created: BILL-1198 "duplicate writes on metering-worker after deploy". I'll attach replay artifacts.

fiona (product): Customer comms ticket PROD-322 created for messaging and manual credits. Matt to own outreach.

jordan (oncall): status summary to post to #incidents after wrap: - Exports paused - Retry flag disabled (canary -> prod) - Bounded replays validating dedupe on sample shards - Affected customers identified and being contacted - Tickets BILL-1198, PROD-322 created - Next steps: full shard replays + reconciliation + postmortem.

matt (support): ETA for first full-shard run?

samir (billing-eng): starting parallel replays on 4 shards now, estimate 70min for first set. I'll update.

incidents-bot: Severity update: remains P2. No broader service outage. Billing export paused.

erin (next-oncall): I'll take over monitoring. Jordan, leaving you in the thread if you want to add anything else before you step off.

jordan (oncall): thanks team. Leaving for break — will be reachable on DM. Keep this thread for async notes. Postmortem owners: samir + elaine.

incidents-bot: Thread closed for active paging at 2143656321 (oncall reassigned to erin).
